about: Part B's entries for THEOREM-CONNECTIVITY-APART.json, for the landing's register stage (U1b's pattern: REASONS and NOW_USED). The roots below are predicted from the two modules' sources (comments stripped, names resolved by namespace; RoomRuns reaches the base through Law.run, so whatever it uses is not apart): 28 roots, each a fact about the rooms' rule, one constructed family of models. The rehearsal's connectivity check gives the exact list; a root it names that is not here, or a name here it does not list, stops for reading. The landing's run named one more, read and added at the landing (1 November 2026): Overshooting.heater_shifted, which nothing uses, since Overshooting.in_phase follows each step itself; 29 roots. now_used: the six register roots, all general-structure, that RoomNet uses and that so stop being roots; their entries go.

Becoming.Rooms.Matched.rows: The matched thermostat's rows of the map at every positive margin: at its set level and once its window opens it keeps, and keeps from some point on, and is neither 生成 nor 全生成 nor 有终 nor 退化. A fact about one constructed family of models (OU7)
Becoming.Rooms.Matched.start_kept: The matched thermostat's opening step at every positive margin, from its set level shut to its set level open: a step of one constructed family of models (OU7)
Becoming.Rooms.Overshooting.generation_s: The overshooting thermostat at a margin of three is 全生成 at its set level and at both open occurrences it reaches: a fact about one constructed model (OU7)
Becoming.Rooms.Overshooting.heater_shift: From two on, the overshooting heater gives as RegimeMargin.Alternation's giving shifted by two: a fact about one constructed model (OU7)
Becoming.Rooms.Overshooting.renewing_ste: In the overshooting thermostat at a margin of three, the opening and every open step are carrying renewals and the shut step is not: a fact about one constructed model (OU7)
Becoming.Rooms.Overshooting.rows: The overshooting thermostat's rows of the map at a margin of three: at its set level neither 全守 nor 有终 nor 退化; once open it generates and is in no other region. A fact about one constructed model (OU7)
Becoming.Rooms.Overshooting.single_line_: «单行则生成后守不并» tested both ways on one constructed model: on the open window's single line generating excludes keeping from some point on, and where the net branches the two hold together (OU7)
Becoming.Rooms.Unheated.b1_b0: The unheated room's last open step at a margin of three, from 1 to 0: a step of one constructed model (OU7)
Becoming.Rooms.Unheated.rows: The unheated room's rows of the map at a margin of three: at its set level it keeps from some point on and is in neither strong form, warmth not constant; once open it is in no region of generation or keeping and reaches an end. A fact about one constructed model (OU7)
Becoming.Rooms.alike_in_core_iff: Within one room of the constructed family, warmth lies in its own core exactly where the heater gives: «温有常当且仅当有给» read through «类有常当且仅当含于核» (OU7)
Becoming.Rooms.before_at_one: The rule read before the exchange takes a heated room at a margin of one out of warmth: a computation on one constructed model (OU7)
Becoming.Rooms.before_pos: Read before the exchange, every step of a heated room lands warm from a margin of two on: a fact about one constructed family of models (OU7)
Becoming.Rooms.before_unheated: Without a heater the two reading orders are one rule: a one-line unpacking of the rooms' own definitions (OU7)
Becoming.Rooms.before_window_moves: Read before the exchange at a margin of three, the window moves both heated rooms' levels: a computation on one constructed model (OU7)
Becoming.Rooms.cold_rests: Once cold, the unheated room's open occurrence at 0 is 全守 at every margin: a fact about one constructed family of models (OU7)
Becoming.Rooms.heated_unended: In a heated room of the constructed family no line of warmth from the set level ends, and none reaches an end, by «有常则往不穷» (OU7)
Becoming.Rooms.heaters_told_apart: At a margin of three the first stage of the level tells the two heaters apart: a fact about one constructed model (OU7)
Becoming.Rooms.joint_converse: A counterexample on the constructed rooms side by side: warmth is not constant under the joint net, yet no line of warmth from a heated room's set level ends, so the converse of «有常则往不穷» fails (OU7)
Becoming.Rooms.shut_one_class_alike: While no window opens, the constructed rooms at their set level are one core class at warm or not, by «核之单调» (OU7)
Becoming.Rooms.shut_rests: While no window opens, every room of the constructed family is 全守 at its set level, whatever its heater (OU7)
Becoming.Rooms.toy_verdict: «恒温与平衡»'s verdict derived from the rooms' rule at a margin of one draw, through toy_branches and «开窗以温层如其余乃分» (OU7)
Becoming.Rooms.unended_at_one: At a margin of one no line of warmth from the set level ends, heater or not: the counterexample showing that «温不穷当且仅当有给» needs a margin of two (OU7)
Becoming.Rooms.«平衡守而有终»: The unheated room at a margin of three keeps, reaches an end and renews on the way, and is neither 生成 nor 退化: a fact about one constructed model (OU7)
Becoming.Rooms.«开窗则一层可分»: With the window in the net, at every positive margin, the first stage of the level tells the unheated room from every heated one: a fact about one constructed family of models (OU7)
Becoming.Rooms.«开窗则平衡新而尽»: Once its window opens, the unheated room at a margin of three degenerates while renewing: a fact about one constructed model (OU7)
Becoming.Rooms.«有给之室以温不可分»: Warm or not does not tell two heated rooms of the constructed family apart: one core class at every positive margin (OU7)
Becoming.Rooms.«温不穷当且仅当有给»: From a margin of two on, no line of warmth from the set level ends exactly where the heater gives: a law of one constructed family of models (OU7)
Becoming.Rooms.«给如所取则全守»: The matched thermostat is 全守 before and after its window opens, at every positive margin: a fact about one constructed family of models (OU7)
Becoming.Rooms.«给过所取则生守相杂»: The overshooting thermostat at a margin of three generates and keeps at its set level, a model case of Map.«生守相杂»: a fact about one constructed model (OU7)
